messages:
Aisha Khan: Hey folks  day 2 question: where do I post onboarding issues like VPN, laptop shipping, or repo access? Also curious which bots I can safely poke without causing noise.
Ben Torres: welcome Aisha! Quick map: hardware & HR -> #people-ops (use the pinned form). VPN and infra access -> #eng-infra. Repo/GitHub access -> open the SSO ticket in #help and include your username.
Lena Schmidt: If it's blocking you now (no VPN, can't clone), post in #help and mention @eng-oncall. That channel is monitored and routed to the right owners.
Aisha Khan: Good to know. I saw a bunch of bots in other channels  are any off-limits?
Infra Bot: Reminder: deploy and pager integrations are restricted. Use #devex-sandbox for testing commands. Do not invoke deploy slash commands in public channels unless you have approval.
Ben Torres: Rule of thumb: sandbox/test-labeled bots = fine to interact with; unknown bots or ones that post infra actions = DM or use sandbox. Also check the channel header/purpose before running anything.
Lena Schmidt: Posting etiquette TL;DR: 1) Search Slack + handbook first. 2) Pick the most specific channel, avoid #general for work questions. 3) Use threads for follow-ups. 4) Include what you tried and minimal logs in fenced code blocks. 5) Never paste secrets; rotate immediately and notify #eng-security if leaked.
Aisha Khan: Example of a good error post?
Ben Torres: "@eng build fails on macbook-pro, ran `make build` and `./scripts/test`  last 6 lines below" + fenced code block of 5-8 lines. For very long traces, use an unlisted gist and link it.
Aisha Khan: If I accidentally post a secret, what's the exact flow?
Lena Schmidt: Delete the message, rotate the credential, then ping #eng-security. There's a secrets-rotation playbook pinned in that channel.
Aisha Khan: Awesome, thanks! I'll use #help for urgent blocks and #devex-sandbox for bot testing. :tada:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Aisha! To re-run your onboarding checklist type `/onboard me` and I'll DM you the remaining items.
